response.overview: The Y2K Bug is defined as: at the turn of the century, a computer program to deal with the date of the Bug, it will cause a variety of systems to malfunction or even crash. This film chronicles the memories of the millennial generation, the generation I was born into, and explores the differences between my mother's generation and my own. With her help, I am able to refine the details of my memories, while also delving into her past experiences in an attempt to heal the shared silence between us.
response.title: The Millennium Bug
